purpose: Concept review for future modeling; not runtime assets
villagers:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one polished landscape CHARACTER CONCEPT SHEET for Threadbound, a side-view 2.5D game set in a medieval / feudal Japanese fishing village. This is concept art for later rigged 3D models, not an actual 3D model or sprite sheet.
Input image 1 is a reference ONLY for the existing blue ceramic roofs, weathered brown timber, cream plaster, fishing nets and village material palette. Input image 2 is a reference ONLY for the existing adult player proportions and the hand-painted/textured 3D rendering style. Do not reproduce its HUD or screenshot layout.
Design exactly TWO distinct, friendly adult Japanese villager characters who belong inside those houses. Adult anatomy about seven heads tall, restrained stylization, believable joints, clear modelable silhouettes, detailed woven cloth and patched materials. Small 3D model geometry with beautiful painted PBR texture detail. Avoid chibi proportions, modern clothes, armor and combat weapons.
A: NET MENDER. Middle-aged woman with tied-up dark hair and a faded indigo head wrap, rolled-sleeve work kimono jacket, beige sash, practical loose cropped trousers, patched brown apron, simple sandals. Warm lived-in face, calloused hands. A compact fishing-net shuttle and a small tangle of hemp cord as work props. Calm, capable expression. Slate blue / indigo / flax / warm brown palette, visibly woven cloth and repaired seams.
B: BOATWRIGHT. Older broad-shouldered but ordinary man with salt-and-pepper hair, short beard, rolled-sleeve faded blue work jacket, ochre-brown canvas waist apron, charcoal work trousers, wooden-soled sandals, a few small wooden pegs in a belt pouch. Friendly tired face. A wooden boat rib or small timber offcut and a compact plane as work props. No giant bags or overly elaborate accessories.
Composition: tasteful pale warm-gray studio sheet with dark indigo typography and plenty of clean spacing. Two clearly separated large columns, each with a large full-body front-three-quarter model view and a smaller back/profile view preserving exactly the same character design. Include small cozy work-idle vignettes beneath: A seated mending a net beside a low stool; B standing inspecting a timber piece at a workbench. Bottom strip shows the interaction intention on A: working idle, turning head and shoulders toward an approaching player, relaxed talking stance, with planted feet. No dialogue text, no speech bubbles. Ambient breathing and small hand work are implied by pose studies, not animation arrows everywhere. Both NPCs are unarmed villagers, not heroes. No busy scenic background behind the main models.
Text exact and limited: title "LAKESIDE VILLAGERS"; column labels "A  NET MENDER" and "B  BOATWRIGHT"; bottom labels "WORK IDLE", "TURN TO PLAYER", "TALK IDLE". High-quality art direction, coherent character turnarounds, readable at game size.
enemies:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one polished landscape ENEMY CHARACTER CONCEPT SHEET for Threadbound, a side-view 2.5D action game in a medieval / feudal Japanese fishing village. This is an original design exploration for later textured rigged 3D models, not an actual game asset.
Input image 1 is reference ONLY for the existing blue roof ceramics, cream plaster, weathered wood and fishing village craft materials. Input image 2 is reference ONLY for the game's adult stylized player proportions and textured 3D art treatment; do not copy the player, white blank face, HUD or screenshot layout.
Explore exactly THREE original ninja-like INDOOR wall-leaping enemies. Shared premise: spring from walls or roof beams, visibly brace before a committed diagonal jump slash, land with a recovery opening; also have one clearly readable thrown projectile. Long, agile adult human proportions, practical Japanese-inspired cloth, weathered materials and restrained blue accents. Original silhouettes: do not depict an existing fighting-game character or copy a Spanish matador, blonde braid, rose, tattoo or three-pronged hand claw. No modern tactical gear, guns, neon armor, cartoon chibi or huge supernatural wings.
A: EAVE RUNNER. Most practical baseline. Lean human masked roof runner, short faded-indigo hood/scarf tied close to head, off-white lower face wrapping, fitted charcoal cloth, short sleeveless indigo jacket, rope belt, a few weathered bamboo splints on forearms and shins, split-toe soft shoes. One short curved utility blade. Thrown weapon: a single dark iron throwing spike with a short pale blue cloth tag. Silhouette compact and readable, close-fitting hems so wall jumps are easy to see. Small exposed eye area, alert body language.
B: THREAD SKIMMER. Tall slim ninja in layered slate-blue and ash cloth, broad cloth cowl, pale angular woven face covering, two short fabric tails at waist, wrapped forearms. Small carved loom-shuttle knife rather than a generic katana. Thrown weapon: three slim blue thread needles in a modest fan, with short faint thread trails. More suspended, gliding, deceptive silhouette, still physically modelable and humanoid.
C: TILE FANG. Stockier compact ambusher with an asymmetric shoulder guard made of the same blue roof ceramic as the village, a cracked off-white ceramic half-mask, charcoal wrapped cloth, dusty blue sash, thick tabi soles and a heavy short single-edged blade. Thrown weapon: one flat triangular ceramic shard. Broad grounded silhouette, powerful knee-tucked wall spring rather than floaty flight.
Composition: pale warm-gray studio background, professional game concept art with rich hand-painted texture/PBR shading, no full scenic environment. Three equal columns each with a large full-body three-quarter character view, a small clear projectile detail and a smaller wall-perched pose showing bent knees and braced feet. Match the project scale and restrained blue palette. Bottom strip dedicated to A shows FOUR small side-view action poses inside a simple timber house: braced wall perch, aim-locked crouch with a small blue weapon glint, diagonal airborne slash with a short blue trailing arc, low landing with recovery. Make the enemy readable on wooden interior backgrounds. Do not imply actual existing gameplay is implemented.
Exact limited text: title "INDOOR WALL HUNTERS"; names "A  EAVE RUNNER", "B  THREAD SKIMMER", "C  TILE FANG"; strip labels "PERCH", "LOCK", "DIVE", "RECOVER". Clean typography, no extra paragraphs, no game UI.
